E1b-05 opened. The diary against the transcript: diary_transcript.py (E1a) drew 17 legs by seed, one per stage and one more among D6a-09 to D6a-18 (A1b-16, B1b-30-p2, B2b-r1, B3a-p2, B4a-05, C1a-07, C2a-02, C3a, C4a, C5c-02-p2, D1a, D2a, D3a-15, D4a-03, D5a-31, D6a-10, D6a-17); their 905 diary lines, 392 found word for word. diary_tool_lines.py (written and run now, output diary_tool_lines.json) reads the other 513 against the leg's tool calls within ten minutes: 185 borne out by a tool call holding the line's ids. Then by hand: 282 placed lines of B1b-30-p2 are rows of the files that leg's b1_multiplace_write4.py runs read (b1_multiplace_b1b30.tsv and b1_multiplace_b1b30p2.tsv, the script J's B1b-29 rule names); 19 more are single placements in that leg's b1_place.py commands (sub t07=T3-043 and the like), all 19 matched; the 27 move lines of C5c-02-p2 (09:22:27 to 09:23:08) were written by c5c2_decl_amend.py from c5c2_decl_spec.json, both written and dry-run in the transcript at 09:21 to 09:22. So 905 of 905 diary lines are borne out by the transcript; no entry is a defect. The loosest test is the TSV one, a row in a file the leg's script read, not a time-matched call per line.

E1b-05 the probes (probes_score.py, E1a; probes_notes.py, written and run now, output probes_notes.json; its first run, the declared rule alone, is kept as .superseded-1). 300 answer files over 16 stages. As filed, probe.py could not read 283 of them, written in bold markdown, so goal is right 17 and missing 283. Re-read by probe.py's own rules against the expected values stored at each close: goal right 298, wrong 2; open right 26, wrong 135, n/a 139; rooms right 48, wrong 125, n/a 127; changed right 50, wrong 13, n/a 237; next right 11, wrong 12, n/a 277. Each wrong answer sorted: a note where the head, the diary or the question files held the answer at the close, a defect where none did. Goal 2, open 135 and next 12 are all notes; changed 9 notes and 4 defects; rooms, by the declared rule (the leg's own diary lines), 24 notes and 101 defects, but the expected rooms repeat across legs that opened nothing (A1b-20 to A1b-26 all expect predators, Russiaclan and winnipegjets), so they are the last rooms on record, and over the stage's diary up to the close 111 are notes and 14 defects. The defects, 18 by the second test: 14 rooms, mostly B1 legs, whose rooms are in the read logs but not in the diary; 4 changed. n/a, 780 answers, is counted apart and never as recall.

E1b-05 the unplaced (unplaced.py, E1a; unplaced_kinds.py, written and run now, output unplaced_kinds.json), read. Second-order themes with no placement: 151 of 7,844, holding 407 concepts; by a declared keyword rule on the label, then read: the sub's own April Fools play 42 (165 concepts), talk about the event with no organizing act (asking what an effort is, admiring, reacting, arguing about the canvas) 72 (186), lost posts whose body is gone or only a title or marker is left 18 (24, all 18 in unplaced-B1.jsonl), and labels naming an act 19 (32). Read by hand, 10 of those 19 name an act the scheme holds and should have been placed: germany/t19 (a build report), h3h3productions/t27 (welcoming people into the drawing), h3h3productions/t30 (arguing duplicate logo proposals), hungary/t05 (a call to turn a neighbour's flag), linux/t03 (writing a bot), oman/t06 (telling a late helper the work was finished), opticgaming/t12 (mourning the lost work), orderofthebluecorner/t02 (planning the sign), rainbowgrid/t06 (taking the grid to other canvases), romania/t18 (the flag's design); the other 9 are joking, ordinary sub talk or a bare message. Concepts unreachable from any theme: none (every concept has its theme). Third-order themes no fourth-order theme took: 2, T3-017 carrying on ordinary sub talk (334 themes), outside the model's scope by design (G59 at D3a-55), and T3-133 recovering a hacked sub (1 theme, rare), a host's act that could have sat with Boundary work. Fourth-order themes no dimension gathered: none.

E1b-05 defects.jsonl: 2 lines appended by out/_analysis/e1b05_defects_lines.py, both the instrument's: the 18 recall-probe misses no record answered (lines 115), and the 10 unplaced themes that name an act the scheme holds (line 116, sure false). The ledger holds 116 lines, 15 of them E1's.
